Talent0_2Ability.name: Intrepid Fang
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When actively attacked from within <color=#F74848>4</color> tiles and both Arms are undestroyed, launches <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Toss]</skill> after combat. <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can additionally block Melee attacks.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Intrepid Fang
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When actively attacked from within <color=#F74848>4</color> tiles and both Arms are undestroyed, launches <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Toss]</skill> after combat. <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can additionally block Melee attacks.
When [Zoey] is on the battlefield, enemy units with <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> deal <color=#F74848>15%</color> less damage when attacking targets other than [Zoey], and take <color=#F74848>15%</color> increased damage from [Zoey].

600001.name: Entrenched 1
600001.SpecificEffects: Triggers <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> to protect allies within <color=#F74848>1</color> adjacent tile from Assault and Ranged attacks. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

601102.name: Unbreakable Will
601102.SpecificEffects: When both Arms are intact, Arm DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-25%</color>.

601103.name: Encroach
601103.describe: Uses a Polearm to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.5x</color> DMG. Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>+20%</color> when retaliated against.

601104.name: Challenge Formation
601104.describe: Uses a Polearm to attack all targets within an I-shaped (<color=#F74848>3x1</color>-tile) area or L-shaped (<color=#F74848>3x1</color>-tile) area ahead, dealing <color=#F74848>0.9x</color> AoE DMG. Gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=6011042>[Upper Hand]</buf> for each target hit, stacking up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times.

601105.name: Seize Momentum
601105.SpecificEffects: After a perfect dodge, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

601106.name: Lightning Hunt
601106.describe: Uses a Polearm to <range type=1>thrust 4 tiles forward</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.7x</color> DMG to the first target hit and inflicting <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

601107.name: Chaotic Advance
601107.SpecificEffects: For each enemy on the battlefield with <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf>, gains Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>12%</color>.

601108.name: Final Verdict
601108.describe: Jumps to any empty tile within <range type=0>4 adjacent tiles</range>, then uses a Polearm to deal <color=#F74848>1.1x</color> AoE DMG to all enemy targets within <range type=1>2 tiles</range>. Applies <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> to all targets hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

600022.name: Armor Specialization 2
600022.SpecificEffects: When performing <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf>, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

601131.name: Survival Protocol 1
601131.SpecificEffects: When dodging an active attack, restores <color=#F74848>4%</color> HP to undestroyed parts after combat. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> combo hit dodged, additionally restores <color=#F74848>1%</color> HP, up to an additional <color=#F74848>8%</color> HP.

600033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
600033.SpecificEffects: At end of action, if no active attacks were used this turn, can move an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles.

601134.name: Survival Protocol 2
601134.SpecificEffects: When completely dodging an attack, <buf ID=6011311>[Survival Protocol 1]</buf> can additionally repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

601135.name: Survival Protocol 3
601135.SpecificEffects: When HP drops below <color=#F74848>50%</color> after taking damage, gains <buf ID=1008062>[Absolute Dodge]</buf> after combat. Can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time, with a trigger interval of <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

601136.name: Survival Protocol 4
601136.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=6011311>[Survival Protocol 1]</buf> additionally restores <color=#F74848>10%</color> HP to undestroyed parts after combat.

601141.name: Predatory Impulse 1
601141.SpecificEffects: After triggering <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Toss]</skill> <color=#F74848>3</color> times, the next active attack does not consume AP and triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> after attacking. Can move <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking. Removed after triggering.

600043.name: Entrenched 4
600043.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can now trigger an unlimited number of times per turn.

601145.name: Predatory Impulse 3
601145.SpecificEffects: After activating <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Toss]</skill>, applies <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> to all targets hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

601146.name: Predatory Impulse 4
601146.SpecificEffects: <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Toss]</skill> DMG increased to <color=#F74848>1x</color> AoE DMG.

hiddenSkills.name: Sync-Guard
hiddenSkills.describe: Protects allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles from Assault and Ranged attacks. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Lasts for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. Also applies <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> to all enemy units within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

Introduction: Colin's adjutant, a hot-headed and defiant man of action.
